thread:
rhea: Quick alert — onboarding sample-app crashes on Node because the published SDK 1.2.3 only has ESM artifacts. stack: `Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'`.

omar: Hmm, which files are in the tarball?

rhea: `npm pack` shows:
```
package/README.md
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/package.json
```
No `dist/node` or typings.

pkg-bot: Publish job link: https://ci.example.com/jobs/2389. Packaging step used `files: ["dist/**", "README.md"]`. Our dts pipeline writes to `dist/_types` so types were omitted. Also the node build output lives in `dist/node/` which the package step mistakenly excluded.

support: We're getting support tickets — TypeScript intellisense is broken for some customers and quickstart fails for Node users.

nina: Possible quick fixes: 1) republish a patch with both cjs+esm and move d.ts to `dist/types/`; 2) temporarily adjust `package.json` exports to point require -> `dist/edge/index.mjs` so older consumers at least import the ESM build (ugly).

omar: I'd prefer full rebuild and republish. Action items: A) update tsup to `format: ['cjs','esm']` and enable dts output to `dist/types`; B) fix `files` in package.json or .npmignore to include `dist/node` and `dist/types`; C) add CI pre-publish check that runs `npm pack` + `tar -tf` and basic node/esm/tsc smoke tests.

rhea: I can cut the hotfix release (1.2.4) after rebuild. I'll also add a temporary line to the onboarding quickstart that recommends `import` for Node >=14 and includes a require snippet that falls back to `await import()` pattern for older bundlers.

pkg-bot: Local validation for 1.2.4-rc: `npm pack` contents: 
```
package/dist/node/index.cjs
package/dist/node/index.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/dist/types/index.d.ts
package/package.json
```
Smoke tests: node require/import ✅, ESM import on Vercel preview ✅, tsc typecheck ✅.

nina: Good. Follow ups: 1) RFC to standardize dist layout per runtime (edge/node/types) and update the `exports` mapping to be explicit ("import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs"). 2) Add a lint script that verifies `package.json` `files` matches actual published layout.

omar: Also add tests that verify retry/auth behavior is identical across bundles; we saw subtle differences between edge vs node auth retries in onboarding flows.

rhea: Filed RFC: https://go.redwood.com/rfc/sdk-artifact-layout and ticket for CI checks. Republishing now, will update this thread when stable is out.

support: Notifying support team and drafting a KB article for users who hit this in the interim.

rhea: Update — 1.2.4 published stable. Quickstart docs updated and support KB linked. Closing once CI PR merges.
